## R Markdown
```{r}
library(brms)
data = read.csv("data.csv")
colnames(data)
dim(data)
str(data)
```

```{r}
#Make Normal shot as reference
data <- data %>%
  mutate(shot.technique.name = relevel(factor(shot.technique.name), ref = "Normal"))
full = glm(Goal~distance_to_goal+shot_angle_deg+shot.type.name+shot.technique.name+shot.body_part.name+under_pressure+n_defenders+n_attackers+def_shotcone,family = binomial, data = data)
summary(full)
```

```{r}
step = stepAIC(full, trace = FALSE,direction = "backward")
step$anova
```

```{r}
step = stepAIC(full, direction = "backward")
```
#Final model has distance_to_goal, shot_angle_deg, shot.technique.name,shot.body_part.name, n_defenders
